name: Ploughman's Plate
description:
Bread, a wedge of hard cheese, a pickle and half an onion arrive on one board. Each part keeps its own sharp flavour; there is no hot course included.

Sold as one individual lunch portion. Price and weight cover the named food only; plates, bowls and cutlery remain with the inn. Drinks and unlisted sides are separate. This meal grants no automatic healing or resting bonus.
